notes.title: First round of 1.3 testing begins!
notes.content:
[h1]Platypus Adventures 1.3 Experimental[/h1]

The time has finally come, I have a playable build for 1.3! I need help to smooth out issues, balance the content, and polish it! 

There's currently no concrete release date in mind for 1.3 going to the main version, but its my hope that it could be ready for Christmas this year 2024, after some thorough testing and feedback gathering here.

The patch includes many new features that I'm excited to get out of the door (finally), such as the Slingshot, the new procedural critter spawner, an overhaul of the world and so much more. 

I am chasing feedback, don't hold back with your thoughts and opinions on [url=https://discord.gg/euQg72B]Discord[/url]
Please focus your attention on the new content, which is located by going to the [b]Secret Swimming Hole[/b] in the [b]Boondaburra Forest[/b] level at the start of the game. 
It is also possible to navigate directly to the new content via the main-menu!

Thanks for reading
- David
